queries: SELECT AVG(media_avg) FROM (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS media_avg FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name) AS per_media_type;
